title: Love the Floral Print
text: Love the Floral Print. This is a pretty plate. I love the floral print. The plate is pretty sturdy. It's made from melamine so I expect it to hold up well. It's a salad plate, so it's not full size. I have been using it for lunch. It definitely dress up the meal a bit!
